scripts.halt-dev: concurrently "npm run halt-local-db" "npm run halt-video-chat-frontend" "npm run halt-signalling-api" "cd web-socket-api/src && docker compose down mysql-db"
scripts.run-video-chat-frontend: cd web-server && docker compose watch web-server-dev
scripts.run-built-video-chat-frontend: cd web-server && docker compose up web-server-prod
scripts.halt-local-db: cd web-socket-api/src && docker compose down mysql-db
scripts.halt-video-chat-frontend: cd web-server && docker compose down web-server-dev
scripts.halt-signalling-api: cd web-socket-api/src && docker compose down signalling-server-prod
